title: RoboJailBench: Benchmarking Adversarial Attacks and Defenses in Embodied Robotic Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a security benchmark for embodied AI systems to test against adversarial jailbreak attacks. While it includes 'Ethical Social Offenses' as one of its 18 safety taxonomy categories, this is treated as a security violation rather than a study of religion, morals, or philosophical ethics.
